rule: The video's main subject must be a reflective, philosophical question about being human (meaning, death, loneliness, identity, love, evil, free will, time, purpose, how to live), explored through a story, character, artwork, film, book, anime or personal essay. Philosophy has to be the point, not decoration on top of something else.
rejectIf: it is mainly about gaming, a game community, a fandom, a streamer or YouTuber, internet drama, memes or satire
it is news, trivia, history facts, a how-to, a ranking, a review or a recommendation list
it is a plain explainer or lecture about a philosopher or a school of thought (Stoicism, Nietzsche, Camus 'explained')
it is mainly social, political or gender commentary on a text
it is motivational, self-help or productivity advice
it is a stick-figure or stock-footage mass-produced video
